task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

calls.candidate: hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), hard RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box)
calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the clause RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box) is the wrong template for the task sentence 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.' RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box) is satisfied whenever holding_box has happened at any time before or after at_exit, so an agent that picks up the box, later drops it, and then steps onto the exit empty-handed satisfies the clause while violating the task: the task requires holding_box at the moment of at_exit. Since 'you must be carrying' is a 'b must' consequent of an 'if' condition (not 'also/too/as well'), the correct template is a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box): at_exit is a one-step event (last step only), so the response closes only if the agent holds the box on that step. Keep the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which is correct for 'on your very next move'.
